title: Evidence-linked architecture review
question: Which capabilities, constraints, risks, and next actions are supported by the source pack?

sources.title: Local-first architecture note
sources.content: The workbench supports local evidence-linked analysis and JSON persistence. Human review is required before findings become reusable outputs.

sources.title: Portfolio delivery note
sources.content: A major risk is presenting generated claims without provenance. The next step should retain source-qualified evidence in cards and reports.
